missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Попытка' is a feminine noun and stays nominative as the subject. 'Первая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'неудачной' is the instrumental predicate after 'была'. A clean model for this noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Попытку' is the accusative direct object of 'сделал'. Feminine -а nouns take the -у accusative ending. 'Последнюю' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Попытки' is the genitive required after 'после' to mean after the attempt. 'Первой' agrees in the feminine genitive. A frequent time expression.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Попытке' is the dative form after 'благодаря', which governs the dative to mean thanks to. 'Многому' is also dative. A core cause-and-result pattern.

Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Попыткой' is the instrumental form required after 'гордиться', which governs the instrumental. 'Каждой' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A core verb-plus-instrumental pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В попытке' uses the prepositional form 'попытке' after 'в' to mark where. 'Надежда' is the nominative subject of 'была'. A reflective descriptive pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Попытки' is the genitive required after 'без' to express absence. 'Ничего' is the genitive object of the negated verb. A motivating everyday saying.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantity word. 'Попыток' is the genitive plural after 'несколько', with the fleeting vowel inserted. 'У него было' frames the possession. A core counting pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Попытки' is the nominative plural subject of 'увенчались'. 'Успехом' is the instrumental governed by the verb. A natural way to report eventual success.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Попытка' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'. 'Эта' is the agreeing demonstrative, and 'усилий' is the genitive plural object. A useful evaluative pattern.
